text:
Riley Ford: Quick sync on the routing editor compact iteration. Primary goals: make reorder less janky, clarify validation, and reduce preview churn. Proto: https://figma.com/file/def

Aisha Khan: Reorder ghosting is the worst right now 100ms lag. Users lose track of the item being dragged. Can we show a persistent semi-opaque ghost and dim the drop targets instead of jumping the whole list?

Tom Nguyen: Also the placeholder height changes during hover which causes the list to reflow. Fix by reserving a constant placeholder height and animate transform only. that prevents scroll jumps.

Carlos Mendes: Validation: inline errors are preferred but make them tertiary (smaller text, muted red) so the rule card still reads primary content. Error summary at top of panel for scannability. Copy suggestion: "Matcher syntax error. Examples: equals, contains, regex. Click for quick fixes."

Layla Brooks: Preview simulation: when dragging/reordering we should debounce sim recalcs to 250ms and show a micro spinner overlay on the snapshot. Also preserve the "sample set" dropdown selection across toggles and navigations. Small toggle state should persist in localStorage.

A11yBot: Keyboard reorder missing: propose Space to pick up, Up/Down to move, Escape to cancel, Enter to drop. Announcements: "Picked up rule \"{name}\"", "Moved to position {n}". Ensure focus returns to the moved item after drop.

Riley Ford: UX decision list: 1) ghosted drag with dimmed drop zones + constant placeholder height, 2) animate transform (no layout reflow), 3) inline muted errors + top-level summary, 4) debounce sim to 250ms + spinner, 5) persist sample set selection, 6) implement keyboard reorder + aria-live strings. I'll update the figma and create tickets under routing-editor epic.

Aisha Khan: small copy tweak for the reorder confirmation: "Applying this reorder may change which rules match first. Preview changes before applying." keeps it action-oriented.

Tom Nguyen: I'll push a small CSS patch: `.rule-placeholder{height:48px}` and `transform: translateY()` animation examples in the spec doc.

Carlos Mendes: I'll draft the error microcopy and the error-summary copy for the panel header.

Layla Brooks: I'll add the spinner component and wire localStorage persistence for the sample dropdown.

Riley Ford: thanks team 39; target: include in next sprint. Tag me on the PRs.
